From there, as capital started to come back it consolidated into stronger names.

This is when HMM had its first insane run to catch up to PONS.

We're in a similar situation right now. As PONS exploded, it was a black hole of liquidity and a few trendy names grew with it. We've seen a lot of the big names that had hype and no community already die off.

This is where capital rotates away from the speculative "oh this might be the next xyz" into "this is a good meme and survived the last drawdown on Robinhood Chain and deserves higher".

thesis is simple:

I still fully believe we're early for Robinhood Chain, and it'll end up being larger than anything we last cycle with Base or Solana.

And if Solana saw multple dogs hit $5B, I see no reason why Robinhood Chain won't have multiple cats hit even higher.

CASHCAT = BONK
HMM = WIF

(but bigger)

I have the same conviction I had at the end of August when people who were sidelined were claiming Robinhood Chain was dead and people who entered late were complaining about how they bought the top.

This is where you capitalize on other people's fear, and you believe in the fundamentals.

Be more bullish 🤔🐈

tweets.text:
I think best R/R onchain remains, and will remain on Robinhood this cycle

Crypto, but on chain especially, is often fuelled by new dynamics that enable speculation and new buyers/flows to push valuations up

In essence you need people to be able to believe for a minute rather than destroying each other on what are largely solved for games. When we've played the game before, the participants know the outcome, the targets are known and rushes for the exit brings valuations/tops down - the euthanasia coaster essentially

Most chains/ecos in crypto suffer from this - you've got highly efficient tooling to smooth out inefficiencies, repeated ideas and a history of the userbase being fucked

RH will have many of the same things, no doubt, but so far it also has new dynamics other chains do not - a global leader in retail trading that can directly onboard users, a large amount of political and social capital that exists outside of crypto, coming to market in conjunction with other onboarding tools like FOMO, access to tech/legal abilities to introduce a new, larger asset class in RWA/stocks on chain in new innovative ways, and what appears to be a good, core group of builders on the chain

I don't think this gets rid of the same issues other chains have had, or makes it immune to them, but the dynamic of what it could be and the market it is open to means imo it offers a lot better opportunity to dream a little bigger than repeating the same games from previous cycles on previous chains

but i also think stonk is cool, hope that eco does well
